title: Combinations
statement_short: Given two integers n and k, return all possible combinations of k numbers chosen from the range [1, n]. You may return the answer in any order.
hint: Small range n <= 20 indicates generating combinatorial sub-choices via decision tree recursion.
why_not: Right: Backtracking explores element selection decisions recursively to build k-sized subsets in O(C(n, k)) time. Not 1D DP: Dynamic programming counts combination totals, but constructing all subset paths requires backtracking. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointer pairs cannot enumerate multi-element combinations. Not Bit Manipulation: Bitmasks pick combinations up to 32 bits, but backtracking is the standard recursive approach.
